title: Laravel Warrant: Row-Level Permissions With Eloquent
content:
Laravel Warrant compiles authorization rules into SQL. Filter Eloquent queries, check individual records, and return per-row abilities from the same rules.

The post Laravel Warrant: Row-Level Permissions With Eloquent appeared first on Laravel News.
